title: Clean Cursing: Return Energy to Its Origin
metaDescription: A precise counter-ritual for sending unwanted energy back to where it came from, without scorched-earth backlash.
excerpt: Prep your altar, ground yourself, and use a three-phase ritual to send disruptive energy back to its source with clarity and care.

sections.heading: Why Gentle Cursing Matters
sections.markdown: Some hexes muddy the water when you only need clarity. Clean cursing focuses on precision: acknowledge the harm, name your boundaries, and redirect the static without shredding your own energy field.

sections.heading: Stage One: Ground + Shield
sections.markdown:
- Sweep your space clockwise with smoke or bells.
- Place a bowl of salt water at the north edge of your altar.
- Visualize a mirrored sphere forming around you, cool and reflective.
- Repeat: *What is not mine returns to where it can be held.*

sections.heading: Stage Two: Name the Return
sections.markdown: Write the source of the disruption on a bay leaf or slip of paper. Hold it over the salt water and speak plainly about what you are returning. Focus on neutral language: *I return this energy to its origin for resolution.* Burn or tear the petition and let the ashes fall into the bowl.

sections.heading: Stage Three: Release + Seal
sections.markdown: Pour the salt water outside or down a drain with intention. Trace a clockwise circle in the air and seal it with three snaps or claps. Imagine the mirrored sphere dissolving as you say: *The boundary is tended. The path is clear.*

sections.heading: Aftercare + Integration
sections.markdown: Sip a grounding tea or eat something warm. Journal for five minutes: *What did I learn about my boundaries?* Close the entry with one practical step you will take to stay resourced.
